card.name: Bylines, dateline and citation punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation or characters at the edge of a news dateline, source credit or catalog entry, such as the open parenthesis after a city name or the period ending a byline. It also fires on digits inside library call numbers.

modes.label: Dateline parenthesis
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after a city and country in a news dateline, before the wire service name.
modes.example: 16th-century Peruvian convent and its historic art eyed for restoration LIMA, Peru<< (>>CNS) — Half-hidden behind palm

modes.label: Closing period of a byline or contact line
modes.description: A period ending a sentence that names a newspaper or gives a phone number.
modes.example: Dennis Lien can be reached at 651-228-5588<<.>>

modes.label: Call number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a library call number or catalog code.

card.plain: It marks the small punctuation and number pieces in news credits and library catalog entries.
